project_tracker_diagnostic: Larger riparian Baccharis with longer willowlike leaves and clustered small discoid heads; usually associated with wetter places than B. neglecta.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.habit: Upright shrub, often in wetter riparian or seep habitats.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, linear-lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, usually longer than in B. neglecta.
morphology_keys.heads: Small discoid heads in clusters; female plants conspicuous in fruit.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
